recitation_surah_112_morning_evening.name: Al-Ikhlas for Morning and Evening
recitation_surah_112_morning_evening.notes: Recite with the other two protection surahs three times at dawn and dusk.

recitation_surah_113_morning_evening.name: Al-Falaq for Morning and Evening
recitation_surah_113_morning_evening.notes: Recite with the other two protection surahs three times at dawn and dusk.

recitation_surah_114_morning_evening.name: An-Nas for Morning and Evening
recitation_surah_114_morning_evening.notes: Recite with the other two protection surahs three times at dawn and dusk.

recitation_surah_112_bedtime.name: Al-Ikhlas Before Sleep
recitation_surah_112_bedtime.notes: Cup the hands, recite the three surahs, blow into the hands, and wipe the body; repeat three times.

recitation_surah_113_bedtime.name: Al-Falaq Before Sleep
recitation_surah_113_bedtime.notes: Cup the hands, recite the three surahs, blow into the hands, and wipe the body; repeat three times.

recitation_surah_114_bedtime.name: An-Nas Before Sleep
recitation_surah_114_bedtime.notes: Cup the hands, recite the three surahs, blow into the hands, and wipe the body; repeat three times.

recitation_surah_112_illness.name: Al-Ikhlas for Illness and Ruqyah
recitation_surah_112_illness.notes: Recite as ruqyah and blow over the body.
recitation_surah_112_illness.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5016; Sahih al-Bukhari 5735; Sahih al-Bukhari 5748

recitation_surah_113_illness.name: Al-Falaq for Illness and Ruqyah
recitation_surah_113_illness.notes: Recite as ruqyah and blow over the body.
recitation_surah_113_illness.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5016; Sahih al-Bukhari 5735; Sahih al-Bukhari 5748

recitation_surah_114_illness.name: An-Nas for Illness and Ruqyah
recitation_surah_114_illness.notes: Recite as ruqyah and blow over the body.
recitation_surah_114_illness.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5016; Sahih al-Bukhari 5735; Sahih al-Bukhari 5748

recitation_ayat_al_kursi_bedtime.name: Ayat al-Kursi Before Sleep
recitation_ayat_al_kursi_bedtime.notes: Recite the full verse before sleep.

recitation_baqarah_285_286_night.name: Last Two Verses of Al-Baqarah at Night
recitation_baqarah_285_286_night.notes: The hadith states that they suffice the reciter for the night.
recitation_baqarah_285_286_night.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5009; Sahih al-Bukhari 5040; Sunan Ibn Majah 1369

recitation_baqarah_home.name: Surah Al-Baqarah in the Home
recitation_baqarah_home.notes: No fixed daily frequency is stated in the cited hadith.

recitation_kahf_friday.name: Surah Al-Kahf on Friday
recitation_kahf_friday.notes: Included as Hasan evidence, not labelled Sahih.

recitation_kahf_first_ten_dajjal.name: First Ten Verses of Al-Kahf for Protection from the Dajjal
recitation_kahf_first_ten_dajjal.notes: Memorise or recite the first ten verses as stated in the narration.

recitation_kahf_last_ten_dajjal.name: Last Ten Verses of Al-Kahf for Protection from the Dajjal
recitation_kahf_last_ten_dajjal.notes: A variant narration specifies the last ten verses.

recitation_sajdah_friday_fajr.name: As-Sajdah in Friday Fajr, First Rak‘ah
recitation_sajdah_friday_fajr.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 891; Sahih Muslim 879a; Sunan an-Nasa’i 1421

recitation_insan_friday_fajr.name: Al-Insan in Friday Fajr, Second Rak‘ah
recitation_insan_friday_fajr.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 891; Sahih Muslim 879a; Sunan an-Nasa’i 1421

recitation_jumuah_friday_prayer.name: Al-Jumu‘ah in Friday Prayer, First Rak‘ah

recitation_munafiqun_friday_prayer.name: Al-Munafiqun in Friday Prayer, Second Rak‘ah

recitation_kafirun_fajr_sunnah.name: Al-Kafirun in the First Sunnah Rak‘ah Before Fajr

recitation_ikhlas_fajr_sunnah.name: Al-Ikhlas in the Second Sunnah Rak‘ah Before Fajr

recitation_baqarah_136_fajr_sunnah.name: Al-Baqarah 2:136 in the First Sunnah Rak‘ah Before Fajr

recitation_al_imran_52_or_64_fajr_sunnah.name: Aal ‘Imran 3:52 or 3:64 in the Second Sunnah Rak‘ah Before Fajr
recitation_al_imran_52_or_64_fajr_sunnah.notes: The narrations mention 3:52 and, in another wording, 3:64. This record points to alternatives, not the entire range.

recitation_mulk_general_virtue.name: Surah Al-Mulk: General Virtue of Intercession
recitation_mulk_general_virtue.notes: The Hasan report establishes intercession and forgiveness, but does not prescribe a specific day or bedtime schedule.

recitation_fatihah_ruqyah.name: Al-Fatihah for Ruqyah
recitation_fatihah_ruqyah.notes: Recite Al-Fatihah as ruqyah. The reports describe its use for a poisonous bite or sting; they do not prescribe a fixed repetition count.
recitation_fatihah_ruqyah.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5736; Sahih al-Bukhari 5737; Sahih al-Bukhari 5749

recitation_qaf_fajr.name: Surah Qaf in Fajr Prayer
recitation_qaf_fajr.notes: An established recitation in the obligatory Fajr prayer. The report does not assign a fixed daily schedule.
recitation_qaf_fajr.reference: Sahih Muslim 458a; Sahih Muslim 458b; Sunan an-Nasa’i 949

recitation_qaf_friday_sermon.name: Surah Qaf in the Friday Sermon
recitation_qaf_friday_sermon.notes: This is a sermon-context practice, not a personal Friday recitation schedule.
recitation_qaf_friday_sermon.reference: Sahih Muslim 872a; Sahih Muslim 872b; Sunan an-Nasa’i 1411

recitation_qaf_eid_prayer.name: Surah Qaf in the First Eid Rak‘ah
recitation_qaf_eid_prayer.notes: An established alternative pair for the Eid prayer.

recitation_qamar_eid_prayer.name: Surah Al-Qamar in the Second Eid Rak‘ah
recitation_qamar_eid_prayer.notes: An established alternative pair for the Eid prayer.

recitation_tur_maghrib.name: Surah At-Tur in Maghrib Prayer
recitation_tur_maghrib.notes: An authenticated instance of the Prophet reciting this surah in Maghrib; it is not presented as mandatory for every Maghrib.

recitation_mursalat_maghrib.name: Surah Al-Mursalat in Maghrib Prayer
recitation_mursalat_maghrib.notes: An authenticated instance of this surah being recited in Maghrib; no fixed recurring frequency is stated.

recitation_dukhan_maghrib.name: Surah Ad-Dukhan in Maghrib Prayer
recitation_dukhan_maghrib.notes: An authenticated instance of this surah being recited in Maghrib. The weak report about Friday-night recitation is not used.

recitation_fatihah_every_rakah.name: Al-Fatihah in Every Rak‘ah
recitation_fatihah_every_rakah.notes: Al-Fatihah is recited in every rak‘ah. This is a core prayer requirement, not an optional reminder schedule.

recitation_ala_witr.name: Al-A‘la in the First Witr Rak‘ah
recitation_ala_witr.notes: This report describes the three-surah sequence practiced by Ibn Abbas for a three-rak‘ah Witr.

recitation_kafirun_witr.name: Al-Kafirun in the Second Witr Rak‘ah
recitation_kafirun_witr.notes: This report describes the three-surah sequence practiced by Ibn Abbas for a three-rak‘ah Witr.

recitation_ikhlas_witr.name: Al-Ikhlas in the Third Witr Rak‘ah
recitation_ikhlas_witr.notes: This report describes the three-surah sequence practiced by Ibn Abbas for a three-rak‘ah Witr.
